unitLookup.includeOwnedUpgradesHint: Nets out upgrades already applied to this character and everything in your inventory (base materials and already-crafted upgrades) from the totals below.
unitLookup.includeOwnedUpgradesSignInRequired: Sign in and sync your Tacticus account to include your owned inventory and character progress in these calculations.
unitLookup.usefulnessScoreHint: Ranks campaigns by value per energy spent: for each still-needed upgrade droppable there, its rarity × amount needed × drop chance is summed, then divided by the energy cost of the battle nodes involved. A higher score means more useful materials per energy. Event difficulty tiers (Standard, Extremis) are combined into one score per event.
